objects.description: During the [Unitronics Defacement Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0031), the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) replaced the existing graphic on the [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) [Human-Machine Interface (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002) with their own, thereby preventing PLC owners and operators from viewing PLC information on the HMI.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: Jamie Tarabay and Katrina Manson December 2023)
objects.description_fa: در طول [کمپین Unitronics Defacement](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0031)، [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) جایگزین گرافیک موجود در [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)]([[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]-4]) شد. (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002) با خود، در نتیجه مالکان و اپراتورهای PLC از مشاهده اطلاعات PLC در HMI جلوگیری می‌کنند.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: Jamie Tarabay and Katrina Manson December 2023) https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003
